views.point_table: one row per committed recording; the full record for the shape, the retention and the whole-record counters

common_window.rule: the largest whole number of nominal revolutions fitting every recording, truncated per recording by its own stored timestamps

common_support.rule: the intersection of every recording's decoded depth range; the supported metrics are computed on each recording's own native gate grid inside it, and no interpolation or resampling is applied anywhere in this report

views.achieved_timing: the profile period is measured from each recording's own stored timestamps; the logs' timing.target_s is carried as provenance (emissions_per_profile x prf_us + 1 ms) and is never used as a measurement

definitions.achieved_period_s: the profile period measured from the recording's own stored timestamps, (t_last - t_first) / (profiles - 1), in seconds; never the log's timing.target_s, which records the retired planning expectation
definitions.duration_s: the retained span of the recording, t_last - t_first from its stored timestamps, in seconds
definitions.meets_usable_interval: duration_s >= 11.52 s (96 nominal 500-RPM revolutions), the pass's usable comparison interval
definitions.period_expectation_s: the planner's own law, acquire/plan.py::profile_period_s (the manual's T_tran + T_prf x (16 + N_PRF)), for the point's decoded emissions and PRF
definitions.zero_fraction: count of samples exactly equal to 0.0 divided by the record length, dimensionless (the whole record, every gate)
definitions.supported_*: the same distributional metrics as reference_repeat.gate_metrics, computed over the common window (window_s, the largest whole number of nominal revolutions fitting every recording) restricted to the common physical support (support_min_mm..support_max_mm); each per-gate statistic is then aggregated across the supported gates by an unweighted mean, so one row is comparable with another whatever its gate count
definitions.is_control: true for the pass's three block-local controls (ctrl-begin, ctrl-mid, ctrl-end), which record the reference condition at the reference window
definitions.declared_accepted_resolution_mm: the pitch the application accepts for the point's requested declared_resolution_mm: the resolution ladder is quantized to c / 12000 mm and snapping is to the nearest rung (acquire/plan.py::clamp_resolution), so a requested 0.617 mm is stored as 0.6166666666666667 mm. resolution_mm is the file's own achieved value and must equal this
definitions.log_target_s: the log's own timing.target_s, carried as provenance: it reproduces the retired law (emissions_per_profile x prf_us + 1 ms) the planner used on the day of the run, and it is not the achieved period. The logs are not rewritten to match a later law

regeneration.note: pass the recorded analysis_commit to reproduce these artefacts byte for byte; the bare command records the current HEAD
